name: a-review-pass-cannot-rewrite-a-reel-alt
breaks: the voice and humanizer passes get the alt text back, and neither carries the post type, so a compliant reel level alt can be condensed into a single frame description by a later stage while the stage that enforced the rule has already run. A screen reader user is then told a 234 photo reel is a picture of four dancers (#1067, L280)
